steps.note: Open the Events list to reach the saved draft.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Confirm the events list rendered successfully.
Open the available saved eRFX draft.
Open the draft's Participants view and its All Vendors window.
Confirm the All Vendors window is open.

args.goal: In the All Vendors window, select the checkbox in the vendor row containing "12 - check@gmail.com", click Cancel, confirm the All Vendors window closes, return to the draft's Participants view, and verify that the vendor remains unselected and was not added by the cancelled action.

steps.note: Perform and verify the buyer-side selection rollback that no dedicated catalog assertion can express.
Confirm the named vendor row is visible again in the Participants view after cancellation.
